title: A buffer overflow when handling DEVICE_RESOLUTION in libXi before 1.8.4 could overflow a heap,… (CVE-2026-109089)
description: A buffer overflow vulnerability exists in libXi before version 1.8.4 when handling DEVICE_RESOLUTION. This flaw could cause a heap overflow triggered by a malicious X server, potentially leading to high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
